summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, deployment, and monitoring—at scale, which goes well beyond calling a hosted model API. You need a platform like these when you are training or fine-tuning custom models, managing reproducible experiments, serving models in production with governance, or orchestrating large distributed jobs; if you only need inference from an existing foundation model, a managed model API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) is simpler and cheaper. The landscape is led by hyperscaler suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) and unified data-and-ML platforms like Databricks, with specialized AutoML and MLOps tools filling niche enterprise needs.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage used (per-second instance billing for training and hosting); no upfront fees, with savings plans available.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native organizations wanting a broad, service-oriented end-to-end ML platform tightly integrated with the AWS ecosystem.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/node-hours, prediction usage, and AutoML training hours; generative AI billed per token or per character.
platforms.best_for: GCP-centric teams and those wanting strong AutoML plus access to Google foundation models like Gemini.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by underlying compute/VM usage plus storage; no separate platform fee, reserved instances available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing strong governance, responsible AI, and integration with Azure OpenAI.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based pricing via Databricks Units (DBUs) plus underlying cloud compute; tiered by workload type.
platforms.best_for: Teams needing unified data engineering and ML/AI on a multi-cloud lakehouse with strong collaboration and open-source MLflow.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.cloud: Cloud-agnostic (SaaS or self-hosted on any cloud)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; usage/seat-based paid plans for teams and enterprise; self-hosted enterprise licensing.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams wanting best-in-class experiment tracking and MLOps observability layered on any training stack.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; costs are only infrastructure for self-hosting, or bundled when used via Databricks.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, framework-agnostic standard for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management without vendor lock-in.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/licensing (custom quote); consumption-based options available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated, low-code model building and governed deployment with limited data-science staff.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.cloud: Cloud-agnostic (open source and managed cloud, any provider or on-prem)
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise products (Driverless AI, H2O AI Cloud) via subscription/licensing.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting powerful AutoML with strong explainability, open-source flexibility, and generative AI options.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.cloud: Serverless (runs on multiple cloud backends, abstracted from user)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based pay-per-second for CPU/GPU compute with scale-to-zero; free monthly credits for starters.
platforms.best_for: Developers and ML teams wanting fast serverless GPU compute for training and inference without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Hub + Inference Endpoints)
platforms.cloud: Cloud-agnostic (managed endpoints on AWS, Azure, GCP)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public use; paid Pro/Enterprise plans, plus usage-based pricing for managed Inference Endpoints and compute.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source and foundation models who want easy access to models, fine-tuning, and managed deployment.
